name: Bottom of Gelkak's Key
summary: Along Darkshore, the Bottom of Gelkak's Key is one of three fragments of a shattered winding key. It belonged to the shipwrecked gnome pirate Gelkak Gyromast, and reef crawlers scavenged it from the shore.

sections.title: Claimed by Crawlers
sections.body: Threshadons sank Gelkak Gyromast's ship off Darkshore, casting the gnome and his belongings ashore. Among them was the winding key that activated his mechanical first mate. The key broke against the coastal rocks into three pieces, and local scavengers descended on the debris. Reef and tide crawlers seized the bottom fragment as they searched the tideline.

sections.title: Reassembly
sections.body: Gelkak needs the bottom fragment, along with the middle and top sections, to activate his mechanical crewman. Coastal murlocs dragged off the middle piece, while inland foreststriders dragged off the top. The gnome pirate must pry this heavy fragment from the shoreline crabs' shells to restore his construct and seek vengeance for his ruined expedition.

faq.q: What is the Bottom of Gelkak's Key used for?
aliases: purpose of bottom of gelkaks key
why do i need gelkak key bottom
faq.answer: The Bottom of Gelkak's Key is one of three pieces needed to repair the winding key that belongs to the stranded pirate Gelkak Gyromast. The repaired key can reactivate his mechanical first mate.

faq.q: Where does this key piece come from?
aliases: where to find bottom of gelkak key
who drops bottom of gelkaks key
faq.answer: Reef crawlers scavenged the key piece from the coast of Darkshore. Encrusted Tide Crawlers and Raging Reef Crawlers search along the water's edge.

faq.q: Why is the key broken into three pieces?
faq.answer: Threshadons wrecked Gelkak's ship, and the key struck the shoreline rocks as he washed ashore. It broke into fragments that scattered among the local wildlife.
Gelkak Gyromast is a stranded gnome pirate on the shores of Darkshore. Threshadons destroyed his vessel and scattered his gear.

angles.text: Engineers will recognize this as part of a specialized winding implement built to power complex clockwork automatons.
As a gnome, you may appreciate that Gyromast relies on clockwork ingenuity rather than a flesh-and-blood crew, even while stranded on a hostile coast.
